dropped.summaryEn: The master said children today are always on mobiles and it was not like that in their time. This is an opinion, not a practice.
The master described joining in 1987, the starting salary and walking seven kilometres to school. This is life story, not a practice.
The master complained that the government gives too much paperwork and teachers have no time to teach. This is a complaint about the system.
Asked for an example of helping a child who found reading hard, the master said it happens by itself if you care and you just need love. This is general advice with no steps.
The master remembered that the school closed for three days during the village fair. This is a memory, not a practice.
